rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation establishes a real aggregate cost omission: the raw March 31, 2026 investment schedule reports total portfolio cost of $2,513,533,478, while the 343 extracted positions sum to $2,312,971,976, a shortfall of $200,561,502 (7.979%). The raw schedule separately reports fixed-income mutual-fund cost of $184,021,376 and money-market mutual-fund cost of $16,951,323, which structurally explains nearly all of the residual, but their combined $200,972,699 exceeds the residual by $411,197. Therefore the aggregate extraction gap is decisive, while an exact row-level culprit is not safely localized and should be escalated for remediation-level reconciliation.
